components.name: success_bonus
components.description: Large positive reward for a successful landing: both legs contact, |x| < 0.1, |vx| < 0.1, |vy| < 0.1, |angle| < 0.1 radians.

components.name: distance_progress
components.description: Progress-delta reward based on change in horizontal distance from pad. Positive when moving closer, negative when moving away.

components.name: vertical_speed_progress
components.description: Progress-delta reward based on change in absolute vertical speed. Positive when slowing down, negative when speeding up.

components.name: angle_penalty
components.description: Small negative reward proportional to absolute angle to encourage upright orientation.

components.name: fuel_penalty_main
components.description: Small negative reward for using main engine to encourage fuel efficiency.

components.name: fuel_penalty_side
components.description: Small negative reward for using side engines to encourage fuel efficiency.

components.name: action_0_bonus
components.description: Small positive reward for selecting action 0 (do nothing) when near the pad and stable. Encourages the policy to stop firing engines during final approach.

components.name: progress_bonus
components.description: One-shot positive reward for achieving a stable near-pad state with both legs contacting. Provides a clear proxy for success.

components.name: crash_penalty
components.description: Large negative reward for crashing (terminated without success).

total_reward_formula: success_bonus + distance_progress + vertical_speed_progress + angle_penalty + fuel_penalty_main + fuel_penalty_side + action_0_bonus + progress_bonus + crash_penalty
